title: Rating
description: A row of five stars for rating something. Stars light up one by one as you hover and morph into filled stars when you pick a rating.

fragments.note: The built-in triggers, plus one of our own for the stars.

fragments.title: One star
fragments.note: A real radio underneath, so the rating works with the keyboard and a screen reader.

fragments.title: Pointer and keyboard set the state
fragments.note: Hover previews, change chooses. Nothing here mentions an icon.

fragments.title: Light the stars up to the pointer
fragments.note: Stars light up one by one as the pointer moves, and go dark at once.

fragments.title: Fill the stars up to the rating
fragments.note: Only the stars that change are in the run.

fragments.title: One star every 80ms
fragments.note: The stagger lives here, in the state changes, not in the icons.

fragments.title: Click the top star to clear
fragments.note: Clicking the top star again clears the rating.
